title.zh: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week
title.en: U.S. SEC's steadiest crypto advocate, Hester Peirce, to depart next week

current_state.zh: SEC委员Hester Peirce已正式提交辞呈，将于10月2日离职；其席位可能不会立即填补。
current_state.en: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce has formally submitted her resignation effective Oct. 2; her seat may not be filled immediately.

updates.what_changed_zh: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, the agency's most prominent crypto advocate known as 'Crypto Mom,' announced she will leave the commission on Oct. 2, a departure disclosed as the SEC issued further crypto policy guidance.

updates.title_zh: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to leave post on Oct. 2

updates.what_changed_zh: Hester Peirce已提交正式辞职信，10月2日生效，确认离职；她还曾担任SEC加密工作组主任，任期已于2025年6月到期。
updates.what_changed_en: Hester Peirce submitted a formal resignation letter effective Oct. 2, confirming her departure; she also served as director of the SEC's Crypto Task Force, with her term having expired in June 2025.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, known as 'Crypto Mom' and head of the agency's Crypto Task Force, submitted her resignation effective Oct. 2, ending roughly eight years at the commission.
